claims.claim_ar: تشبيه باستخدام كَأَنَّمَا في: «كَأَنَّمَا أُغْشِيَتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ قِطَعًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مُظْلِمًا» — تصوير حال الوجوه بمقارنة حالها بقطع الليل المظلم.
claims.claim_en: A simile introduced by 'ka'annama' in «كَأَنَّمَا أُغْشِيَتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ قِطَعًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مُظْلِمًا», comparing their faces being covered to pieces of a dark night.
claims.needs_review_reason: The supporting source chunk contains a general statement 'هذا من التشبيه المركب' (about a simile) but is not an exegesis of this specific verse; the identification of كَأَنَّمَا as a simile here is philologically straightforward but the exact rhetorical classification (simple vs. مركب) may need confirmation from a tafsir-balagha source directly treating Q10:27.
claims.rhetorical_effect: creates a vivid visual simile that intensifies the image of shame and spiritual darkness over the wrongdoers' faces

claims.claim_ar: تصوير استعاري/تمثيلي في «أُغْشِيَتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ قِطَعًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مُظْلِمًا» — استعمال صورة «قطع من الليل» كاستعارة لتشظّي الظلام على الوجوه.
claims.claim_en: A figurative/imagistic use in «أُغْشِيَتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ قِطَعًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مُظْلِمًا», using the image 'pieces of night' as a metaphor for the dark covering of faces.
claims.needs_review_reason: The source chunk fragment 'على التمثيل بالعروس' attests to use of representational imagery in tafsir examples but does not comment specifically on this verse; labeling this phrase as metaphorical imagery is plausible but would benefit from a direct classical tafsir-balagha citation on Q10:27.
claims.rhetorical_effect: conveys fragmentation and intense obscuration, enhancing the sense of humiliation and disorientation

claims.claim_ar: نفي وتوكيد حَصْري في «مَا لَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍ» — تأكيد استحالة وجود ناصر أو عاصم لهم عند الله.
claims.claim_en: A negation/limitation (restriction) in «مَا لَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍ», emphasizing that there is no protector for them from God.
claims.needs_review_reason: The supporting chunk discusses the use of the particle lām for emphatic negation in a different context; applying this to the negation in this verse is reasonable, but confirmation from a source explicitly treating this construction in Q10:27 is recommended.
claims.rhetorical_effect: emphatically removes hope or recourse, underscoring the utter abandonment and finality of the punishment

warnings: The provided source chunks are general tafsir/philological fragments (Zamakhshari, iʿrāb, etc.) and do not all discuss S10:A27 specifically. Each claim is derived by matching rhetorical terminology or descriptive phrases found in those chunks to features of the verse; direct classical balagha commentaries on Q10:27 were not supplied and would strengthen or revise these attributions.

Some device classifications (e.g., whether an image is best called تَشْبِيه مركب vs. استعارة vs. مجاز) can vary among commentators; confidence levels are set accordingly and several claims are recommended for review against dedicated tafsir-balagha sources (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti) if available.
